summary: E-Power Inc., a Chinese foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, filed a 6-K reporting it regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement. A deficiency letter dated May 20, 2026 gave the company until November 16, 2026 to cure. Nasdaq's October 5, 2026 letter confirmed Class A ordinary shares closed at $1.00 or above for ten consecutive business days from September 21 to October 2, 2026, and the matter is closed. No deal, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms involved; this is a routine listing-compliance update, not a special situation.
